description: React component for configuring MCP server costs, allowing users to set default and per-tool override costs with UI elements like input fields, tooltips, and collapsible sections.

methods.name: handleDefaultCostChange
methods.description: Handles updates to the default cost per query, updating the value and invoking the onChange callback.

methods.name: handleToolCostChange
methods.description: Handles updates to individual tool costs, updating the value and invoking the onChange callback.
